notes.title: Shop!
notes.content:
Added a shop

Participants receive money each time they catch a potato
The shop opens at the end of each round
Participants can only obtain one of each item type: Throwables, Hand Modifiers, Potato Modifiers
Items and their effects used in a round will dissipate once the round is over


Added items for the shop

Pie - Throwable Hit another participant to splat their screen
Beehive - Throwable Hit another participate to make their head swell


More store items will come as we test and implement new ideas.

notes.title: New Main Menu and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
New Content

Added a new main menu to simulate joining from the dark web
Added static when switching camera in spectate mode
Added fake profiles to spectate mode if it can't retrieve your friends list


Fixes

Finally fixed a dead player from receiving the potato
Fixed simulated chat in spectate mode not showing usernames and profile pictures

notes.title: Added Spectate and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

Fixed death check


Features:
Added spectate screen
